receipt.name: WarmJpeg
receipt.jitPolicy: Tiered compilation disabled; fully optimized JIT before measurement
receipt.recipe: HorizontalFlipInput.Create(8): original 513x259 asymmetric RGBA8, phase zero, alpha zero at both first-row ends, hidden RGB unchanged. JPEG source alpha is flattened once onto RGB 0x204060; target is opaque 8-bit 4:2:0. No extra source raster. Fresh forward-only Stream wrapper over fresh owned MemoryStream storage; original fixed Huffman path.
receipt.qualityPolicy: fixed-anchor-v1: native qscale 5 / managed quality 69 / 4:2:0; one owned evaluation; no quality sweep
receipt.outputBoundary: Fresh forward-only Stream wrapper over fresh owned MemoryStream storage; wrapper creation/disposal and storage growth included; no seek/length/position access.

nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm JPEG FFmpeg worker

receipt.boundary: Resident original RGBA8 to complete independent JPEG bytes: explicit single-round alpha flattening and normalization on 0x204060, full-range BT.601 conversion, 4:2:0 encode, output acquisition/release. Native codec/conversion/scratch/frame/packet wrappers reused, but pixels are flattened/converted and encoded every operation. Fresh managed MemoryStream creation, growth, encode and disposal included, plus fresh forward-only Stream wrapper creation/disposal; no redundant ToArray. Native optimal Huffman and managed fixed Huffman recorded. Quality matched by frozen <=0.25 dB RGB source-error band; fresh geometry/decoder/alpha/source/ownership/bitstream checks before/after. Startup, IPC, I/O, fixture generation, quality enumeration and checks excluded.
